subject: Recap & next steps: event ledger exportability + compliance intake (CareWell)
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Jamie Tran <jamie.tran@carewell.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Recap: May 11 compliance sync - event ledger & SOC2 timeline

Jamie — thanks for carving out time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our call so CareWell has a single reference.

What we covered (high level):
- SOC 2: Redwood currently maintains SOC 2 Type I (controls design) and we are mid-way through a Type II engagement kicking off Q2 2027; expected report delivery target: late Q3 2027.
- Regulations: Platform supports GDPR controls and a HIPAA-appropriate deployment for covered workloads (BAA options available for Private deployments).
- Event ledger (auditability): We expose admin activity and API-call event streams, retention policies, and configurable export pipelines. You asked about export formats and immutability guarantees.

Immediate ask from you: start the vendor security questionnaire + request sample of an admin export.

Our proposed next steps:
1) I will drop a short capability brief (attached) and a small sample admin export (NDJSON gz) showing schema and manifest.
2) You share the vendor questionnaire link (or we can start one in the Drive folder I created).
3) Technical deep-dive with our infra engineer (30–45m) to walk through the export API, signed manifests, and retention lifecycle — propose Wed 5/13 or Thu 5/14.

Attachment stubs: redwood_event_ledger_capabilities.pdf (2p), sample_admin_export.ndjson.gz (1.2MB stub)

Open items we promised to follow up on:
- Concrete export formats (CSV, NDJSON, Parquet) and which fields are included for admin events.
- How we prove immutability (signed manifests + timestamped digests; export workflow details).
- KMS/HSM integration for key management and encryption-at-rest details.
- Region-specific data residency (we can pin export region to us-east or eu-west on request).

If that summary looks good, I can: (a) start the questionnaire doc in Drive and invite your security contacts, (b) book the technical call with Sergio, and (c) share SOC 2 evidence checklist (redacted artifacts).

Thanks — Jordan
Jordan Blake

From: Jamie Tran <jamie.tran@carewell.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@carewell.com
Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 09:28:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Recap: May 11 compliance sync - event ledger & SOC2 timeline

Thanks Jordan — helpful summary. A few clarifying questions before we kick off the formal questionnaire:

1) Export format & fidelity: Can you confirm whether exports include full request/response metadata for API calls (headers, timestamps, user id, caller IP), or is that filtered for PII? We need the full event context for our forensic requirements.
2) Immutability: You mentioned signed manifests — are those cryptographic signatures we can verify independently? What is the retention of those manifests?
3) Delivery: Can exports be delivered to an S3 bucket in our account (preferred) and optionally to a secure FTP? Any support for streaming to our SIEM?
4) SOC 2 artifacts: We will need a redacted evidence index and the assertion letter (once available) to show our auditors.

Two administrative items: procurement asked for a copy of your standard BAA and any relevant data flow diagrams for HIPAA workloads. Also please add our security lead (security@carewell.com) to the Drive doc once created.

If you can answer the bullets and drop the sample export, we can triage internally and schedule the deep-dive. Prefer Thu 5/14 10:00am ET for the engineer call if that works.

—Jamie
Jamie Tran
Head of IT & Security | CareWell Solutions
jamie.tran@carewell.com

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Jamie Tran <jamie.tran@carewell.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 13 May 2027 08:01:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap: May 11 compliance sync - event ledger & SOC2 timeline

Jamie — great questions, answers below and attaching the NDJSON sample and SOC 2 evidence index stub. Also created a Drive folder and invited your security alias.

Answers:
- Export fidelity: Our admin export schema includes request/response metadata (timestamp, request_id, caller_identity, IP address when available, full action payloads). PII fields are present by default in admin logs to support forensics, but we offer field-level redaction rules on export. See sample_admin_export.ndjson.gz attached.
- Immutability: Exports can be accompanied by a signed manifest (Ed25519) and a SHA-256 digest for each chunk. The manifest is produced at export time and persisted for 7 years by default (configurable). You can verify signatures using the public key we publish in the manifest endpoint.
- Delivery options: We support direct S3 delivery to your account (preferred) with SSE-KMS, HTTPS endpoints, and a streaming forwarder compatible with common SIEMs (Splunk, Datadog, Sumo). We'll send a short runbook for S3 bucket setup (least-privilege IAM role).
- SOC 2 artifacts: Attached soc2-evidence-index.xlsx is redacted sample mapping controls to artifacts; full artifacts can be shared under NDA/SAA.

Proposed technical deep-dive: Thu, 14 May 2027 13:00 PT / 16:00 ET — Sergio (infra) will cover the export API, manifest signing, and retention lifecycle; Laura (platform PM) will run through redaction and retention config UI.

Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c_redwood_cw_questionnaire (invited security@carewell.com)

I attached: sample_admin_export.ndjson.gz (schema + 50 example events), redwood_event_ledger_capabilities.pdf, soc2-evidence-index.xlsx

If that schedule works, I will send a calendar invite to lock it in.

Best — Jordan
Jordan Blake
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
